fixture_kind: synthetic CPU reference inputs; not recorded model responses
purpose: Research a question through platform-specific source specialists.
mechanism: DeepResearchFlow collects URLs, dispatches specialists by source type and synthesizes their structured output.
experiment: Give every specialist the same duplicated story and measure whether synthesis mistakes repetition for independent confirmation.
production: Set per-specialist deadlines and token budgets, preserve source identities and require enough distinct evidence before claiming consensus.
